why: The heading 'I’ve updated the state, but the screen doesn’t update' exists (line 343). zustand's docs are built by pmndrs/docs (.github/workflows/docs.yml), whose heading ids keep punctuation: title.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+|-+/g, '-') gives exactly #i’ve-updated-the-state,-but-the-screen-doesn’t-update. On GitHub the link does not jump, so an info note saying so is right; a warning that the page has no such heading is the false positive.

absent.message: The heading “I’ve updated the state, but the screen doesn’t update” is on this page, but its GitHub anchor is `#ive-updated-the-state-but-the-screen-doesnt-update`: `#i’ve-updated-the-state,-but-the-screen-doesn’t-update` works only on a docs site whose slugger keeps punctuation.
